L.description: Avalon Boonton is  just a half mile from New Jersey Transit and offers studio, one, two, and three bedroom apartment homes for lease. This pet friendly community  features thoughtfully designed living spaces with modern kitchens and quartz countertops. Community amenities include a fitness center, outdoor pool, resident lounge, and courtyard with gas grills. Avalon Boonton is convenient to Florham Park, Montville, Mountain Lakes, Morristown, and Parsippany and is also close to I 287 and I 80, making commuting a breeze.
L.long_highlight: Avalon Boonton offers a warm welcome to pet owners with its dedicated pet spaces and spa services, highlighted by rave reviews. Located in the charming town of Boonton, NJ, this community provides excellent access to I-287 and I-80, easing commutes while being convenient to several nearby towns. Residents speak highly of the modern kitchens featuring quartz countertops and stainless-steel appliances, creating an inviting space for culinary enthusiasts. The property boasts a range of amenities from an outdoor pool to a clubhouse, ensuring varied entertainment and leisure options. Exceptional conveniences, such as proximity to transit options and an array of parks and recreation nearby, make Avalon Boonton a delightful place to call home. Enjoy a seamless blend of comfort, style, and community vibrancy in this highly-favored locale.
L.short_highlight: Avalon Boonton stands out with its pet-friendly environment and luxurious amenities, offering something special for everyone. Located just a short distance from major highways and public transportation, it provides the perfect balance of accessibility and tranquility. Enjoy modern kitchens, a state-of-the-art fitness center, and a relaxing outdoor pool in a community tailored for comfort.
L.highlight_title: Pet-friendly oasis with modern amenities and convenience.

L.description: The Botanic offers luxury living with stunning views, inspired design and spacious floor plans in the heart of New Jersey's newest intersection of entertainment, shopping, and dining. Located just across the street from the Carteret Performing Arts and Events Center, and less than a 10 minute walk to the Marina. The community design provides a contemporary urban flare that recognizes the art and music heritage throughout the city. Boasting many sought-after amenities, including a resident lounge, fitness center, multiple courtyards and 15,000 sq feet of rooftop space, welcome to the Botanic, where every day, your journey is the destination.
L.long_highlight: Embrace luxury living at The Botanic, a highly sought-after property in the heart of Carteret. With direct access to vibrant entertainment and dining options, including the nearby Carteret Performing Arts and Events Center, residents enjoy an engaging urban lifestyle. The property is a top favorite, boasting spacious and modern apartments illuminated by natural light from large windows. Residents rave about the stunning rooftop lounge, perfect for relaxation with breathtaking views. The exceedingly convenient location offers seamless commuting via a direct bus line to NYC, while the well-equipped fitness center meets all your wellness needs. Pet lovers will find this community especially welcoming, as it allows both cats and dogs.
L.short_highlight: The Botanic is a luxurious haven in Carteret, offering a wealth of top-tier amenities and stunning rooftop views. Located next to the bustling Carteret Performing Arts and Events Center, it places residents amidst vibrant entertainment and dining options. This highly favored property welcomes both cats and dogs, appealing to pet lovers seeking a contemporary lifestyle.
L.highlight_title: Premier Carteret hub for entertainment and relaxation.

L.description:
Refined yet welcoming, The Ivy Apartments introduces resort-style living to the quaint and historic town of Chatham, NJ. Our apartments offer over 34,000 square feet of exciting amenity spaces that blur the line between indoor and outdoor living. And with tree-lined streets, local boutiques, vibrant dining spots, and effortless connectivity to New York, our community truly has it all.

Our one, two, and two bedroom plus den homes are as spacious as they are stylish. Soaring nine to eleven-foot ceilings, luxury plank floors, and quartz countertops create a sophisticated ambiance to return to. Shaker vanities, linen storage, and custom wine storage are part of all our apartments in Chatham, NJ, with a select few also boasting wine bars, dens, and elegant kitchen islands.
L.long_highlight: Nestled in the heart of Chatham, The Ivy stands out with its prime location and wealth of amenities, making it an attractive choice for many. The property is perfectly situated for easy access to local conveniences, including shops, restaurants, and public transportation, ensuring a comfortable and enjoyable living experience. Residents appreciate the modern and well-equipped amenities such as a fitness center, clubhouse, and a variety of communal spaces. Reviews highlight the responsiveness of the management team, ensuring satisfaction and peace of mind for all tenants. Both dogs and cats are welcome, making it a great home for pet owners. With its distinctive community atmosphere, The Ivy provides a harmonious and inviting passage to a vibrant lifestyle.
L.short_highlight: The Ivy offers a prime location in Chatham with an array of amenities that cater to an enjoyable lifestyle. Residents delight in the quick access to local shops and public transportation. The welcoming community atmosphere and a highly-rated management team further enhance the living experience here.
L.highlight_title: Charming locale with premium amenities and convenience.

L.long_highlight: The HIGHLAND stands out for its luxurious new construction and prime location in a peaceful neighborhood. Just five minutes from the Highland Avenue train station, commuting to New York City is convenient. Residents describe enjoying modern, high-end finishes and spacious layouts in their homes. The property is pet-friendly, accommodating both cats and dogs, and boasts a dedicated dog park, making it ideal for pet owners. Community amenities such as a fitness center, outdoor courtyard with grills and fire pits, and gated garage parking enhance the vibrant yet tranquil living environment. With no amenity fees, residents can indulge in luxury without added costs.
L.short_highlight: The HIGHLAND offers a luxurious living experience in the serene neighborhood of Orange, NJ. With a quick five-minute connection to the Highland Avenue train station, commuting is seamless. Residents rave about the high-end finishes, spacious layouts, and extensive amenities, including air conditioning, in-unit laundry, and a pet-friendly environment with a dedicated dog park.
L.highlight_title: Luxury lifestyle in a quiet yet connected location.

L.description: Welcome to Cedar Street Commons - Livingston's Premier Senior Living CommunityCedar Street Commons offers a vibrant, maintenance-free lifestyle for independent adults in a beautifully landscaped setting. This non-assisted care, adult community combines comfort, convenience, and connection, making it a place you'll be happy to call home.Our thoughtfully renovated apartments feature modern stone countertops, stainless steel appliances, in-unit washers and dryers, dishwashers, stoves, and refrigerators. Each unit is also equipped with a medical emergency alert button and audio warnings for smoke and fire to ensure peace of mind.At Cedar Street Commons, we believe in creating a fulfilling and engaging lifestyle. Enjoy a host of amenities and services designed to support your well-being and social life, including:        Complimentary bus service three times a week for shopping trips to local grocery stores and shops along Livingston            Game nights held three times a week
L.long_highlight: Located in Livingston, NJ, Cedar Street Commons is a top-toured senior community praised for its beautifully landscaped grounds and modern amenities, such as stone countertops and in-unit laundry. Cats and dogs are both welcome, enhancing the sense of home. Residents appreciate the vibrant atmosphere with planned social activities, such as day trips and exercise classes. Safety is prioritized with medical emergency alert systems and smoke detectors in each unit. With schools, parks, and restaurants nearby, Cedar Street Commons combines convenience and community for a fulfilling lifestyle.
L.short_highlight: Cedar Street Commons offers a premier senior living experience with beautifully landscaped grounds and a maintenance-free lifestyle. Residents enjoy an array of modern amenities like stainless steel appliances and in-unit washers and dryers, adding convenience to daily living. Engaging social activities, such as day trips and exercise classes, foster a vibrant community atmosphere.
L.highlight_title: Vibrant retired lifestyle in a community setting.

L.long_highlight: Nestled in the heart of Montclair's lively arts district, Two South Willow stands out for its prime location and upscale living environment. Residents love the modern facilities, where each apartment boasts spacious interiors and premium finishes, complemented by views of the Manhattan skyline from the rooftop terrace. The property garners top interest from renters, thanks to its proximity to a wide range of restaurants, retail, and public transportation options, all within walking distance. The community is enriched by top-notch amenities like a fully-equipped fitness center featuring Peloton bikes, a tranquil rooftop study with a fireplace, and communal fire pits for social gatherings. Friendly and efficient staff further enhance the welcoming atmosphere, making it an exciting place to call home.
L.short_highlight: Two South Willow offers a vibrant living experience in Montclair's dynamic arts district, known for its culture, dining, and entertainment. The property is a top choice for renters, praised for its modern, well-maintained facilities and exceptional amenities. Enjoy breathtaking Manhattan skyline views from the rooftop terrace, and make use of features such as a fitness center, business center, and outdoor grilling stations.
L.highlight_title: Dynamic Montclair arts district with stunning skyline views.
